messages:
Jordan: Heads up — proposal: introduce a lightweight constraint/schema layer for runtime config flags. Purpose: prevent unsafe combos, make rollouts declarative (percent/metric), and give console/server consistent validation. Sketch below. Thoughts?

Arya: +1 on preventing combo bugs. We keep running into weird interactions between `enable_batching` and short timeouts. Who owns validation? Control plane or runtime? :thinking_face: 

Sam: I think validation should be server-side in the control plane (before writes) but also enforced at runtime as a safety net. We must avoid breaking existing configs — soft warnings first.

Maria: Console UX: we need to show "validation state" inline on the flag editor and a per-route "effective config" preview. Also a timeline for rollouts.

Jordan: rough schema idea (proto/JSON schema to register per-flag):
```json
{
  "flag_key": "string",
  "type": "enum([boolean, integer, float, string, enum])",
  "constraints": {
    "min": "number?",
    "max": "number?",
    "allowed_values": "[string]?",
    "incompatible_with": "[flag_key]?",
    "required_if": "{ flag_key: value }?"
  },
  "rollout": {
    "mode": "enum([instant, gradual])",
    "gradual": {
      "metric": "string (e.g. p95_latency)",
      "percent": "0-100",
      "duration_minutes": "int"
    }
  }
}
```

Sam: A few operational notes: emit `flag.validation` telemetry with severity (info/warn/error) and sample for high-card metrics. Also, add an admin API to preview validation against a candidate config.

Arya: for hierarchy: validate with precedence org -> route -> request. Also, route overrides must declare their lifecycle (ephemeral vs persistent) so we can auto-clean ephemeral overrides after deploy.

Maria: For rollout API, API shape suggestion: `PATCH /api/v1/configs/:id/rollout { "mode": "gradual", "metric": "p95_latency", "percent": 20, "duration_minutes": 60 }`. Console should render a simulated traffic split and expected metrics.

Sam: Can we support "incompatible_with" as bidirectional? Otherwise authors forget to mark reverse side. Maybe validation generation can auto-add reverse constraints at registry time.

Jordan: Implementation plan: 1) schema registry service (store schema + compatibility rules) 2) control-plane validation hook (soft warns for 2 weeks) 3) console changes (editor + rollout UI) 4) runtime enforcement fallback (safety killswitch) 5) hard enforcement after opt-in window. Target: 2 sprints for MVP for hosted.

Sam: Also add a tenant-level opt-out flag for Dedicated/Private customers; some customers want to retain legacy behavior.

Arya: Agree. Will open infra ticket for schema-registry + validation hook. Need SLO for validation latency (<100ms on writes).

flags-bot: Created TICKET-2026: schema-registry + validation-hook (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TICKET-2026) :white_check_mark:

Maria: One more: telemetry naming conventions. `config.validation.result` with tags: severity, flag_key, org_id, route_id, validation_rule. Keep payload small.

Jordan: OK I'll draft the design doc with examples and backwards-compatibility rules, and ping reviewers. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
